items.html:
Another up and coming young fast bowler. At times a little erratic but three
months at the Dutch Cricket Academy in Cape Town in 2002-03  should help his
development. Should use the 2003 world Cup to gain as much experience as
possible and establish himself as a worthy opening bowler. Thought he had
worked out Muralitharan's bowling in the Champion's trophy but still remains
a strong contender for the number 11 position!
Toured
England with the Dutch Colts in 1996 and in the squad for the International
Youth Tournament in Bermuda 1997.
